test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is Can.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's consider each option-

 
 
• *Can- Be **able to**.*
 
• Should- Used to indicate obligation, duty, or correctness, typically when criticizing someone's actions.
 
• Would- past tense of will, used in auxiliary function to express plan or intention
 
• Could- past of can,used to indicate possibility.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate word to fill the blank is 'can'.
 
• Thus, option 1 is the correct answer.

The correct sentence is: *Their pillar-like legs can carry their great weight.*
